posts.trend: Daughter's school admission cancelled after paying Rs 21,000 admission fee; refund denied despite no class
posts.context: Indian parents readily hand over huge deposits for schools out of systemic pressure, ignoring basic financial sense.
posts.angle: The compliance culture of Indian parents makes them the easiest targets for institutional scams.
slides: "Beta, school ka form fill kiya ya nahi?"

"Form fee is ₹21,000."
"No class has started yet."
"They won't refund if we cancel."
"But they have a swimming pool on the third floor."

Tumhara beta abhi chalna bhi nahi seekha.

Thoda adjust kar lo.
posts.caption: Whose mother is this? 🏊‍♂️
posts.rank_verdict: Putting the entire load-bearing landing slide in Hindi makes it completely untravelable for an outsider.
